title: Field-to-billing release
notes: Added Billing Queue for owner, admin and accounting roles so approved field tickets are clearly separated from work still waiting on review.
Approved field tickets can now create invoice drafts without retyping the customer, job, PO/AFE, work description or service quantities.
Existing customer-specific and standard price-sheet matches are used when Northborn can identify the ticket service item.
Added printable field ticket customer copies with company, job, unit, operator, time, quantities, disposal details, service rows and captured signature.
Printable ticket copies can be printed or saved as PDF directly from the billing workflow.
